articles.title: Cantor is advising crypto bank AMINA on path to potential public listing
articles.snippet: The Swiss bank is exploring multiple paths to the public markets, though discussions are ongoing and no final decision has been made.

articles.title: Securitize builds Wall Street credentials with SEC adviser license as tokenization expands
articles.snippet: The license broadens the BlackRock tokenization partner's offering as regulators weigh rules for onchain investment products.

articles.title: Bitcoin is back above $65,000 as U.S. and Iran hold fire. Oil drops 5%
articles.snippet: ETH outperforms BTC, hinting at potential altcoin rally, as the U.S. and Iran hold fire and oil drops.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business
articles.snippet: The deal brings wallet technology to Payward’s enterprise platform, potentially reducing the number of infrastructure providers businesses need to integrate with.
